title: The TBK1-OTUB2-IRF3 signalling complex promotes neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration
title_zh: TBK1-OTUB2-IRF3 信号复合物促进神经炎症与神经退行性变
abstract: Abstract The cyclic GMP-AMP synthase (cGAS)-stimulator of interferon genes (STING) pathway-mediated chronic inflammation drives neurodegeneration in natural aging and various neurodegenerative diseases, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Here, we identify Otubain-2 (OTUB2) as a pivotal regulator that orchestrates the STING signalosome to amplify inflammatory responses. The function of OTUB2 in neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration was investigated through genetic deletion and pharmacological inhibition of OTUB2 in hTARDBP transgenic mice​, adeno-associated virus-mediated TDP43 overexpression mice, and aged mice. Biochemical assays were performed to dissect underlying molecular mechanisms. OTUB2 inhibited K63 ubiquitination of TANK-binding kinase 1 (TBK1), thereby suppressing TBK1 kinase activity and promoting cell death mediated by hyperactivated receptor-interacting serine/threonine-protein kinase 1 (RIPK1). Additionally, OTUB2 functioned as a scaffold facilitating assembly of the TBK1-interferon regulatory factor 3 (IRF3) signalling complex, a prerequisite for IRF3 phosphorylation, and enhanced IRF3 dimerization by reducing its K11 ubiquitination. Genetic deletion or pharmacological inhibition of OTUB2 significantly ameliorated neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration in both ALS and aged mouse models. This study establishes OTUB2 as a critical regulator of cGAS-STING signalling and a potential therapeutic target for neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration.
abstract_zh: 摘要：环状GMP‑AMP合成酶（cGAS）-干扰素基因刺激因子（STING）通路介导的慢性炎症驱动自然衰老及多种神经退行性疾病（包括肌萎缩侧索硬化症，ALS）的神经退行性变。在本研究中，我们鉴定了Otubain‑2（OTUB2）为关键调控因子，能够协调STING信号体以放大炎症反应。通过在hTARDBP转基因小鼠、腺相关病毒介导的TDP43过表达小鼠以及老化小鼠中进行OTUB2的基因敲除和药物抑制，探讨了OTUB2在神经炎症和神经退行性变中的功能。生化实验揭示OTUB2抑制TANK‑binding kinase 1（TBK1）的K63泛素化，从而抑制TBK1激酶活性并促进由过度激活的受体相互作用丝氨酸/苏氨酸蛋白激酶1（RIPK1）介导的细胞死亡。此外，OTUB2充当支架，促进TBK1‑干扰素调节因子3（IRF3）信号复合物的组装，这是IRF3磷酸化的前提，并通过降低其K11泛素化增强IRF3二聚化。OTUB2的基因敲除或药物抑制显著缓解了ALS和老化小鼠模型中的神经炎症和神经退行性变。本研究确立了OTUB2为cGAS‑STING信号通路的关键调控因子，并为神经炎症和神经退行性变提供了潜在的治疗靶点。
